title: Login and Mission Selection Success
description: Verify user can log in with valid credentials and select a mission from the Mission Control dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username and password
Click login button
Confirm user is authenticated and redirected to Mission Control dashboard
Select a mission from the dashboard
Selected mission loads with related task boards and assets

title: Kanban Task Creation and Organization
description: Verify that user can create security testing tasks and organize them on the Kanban board with priorities and tags.

steps.description: Navigate to Kanban board for selected mission
Create a new security testing task with title, description, and assign priority and tags
Drag and drop task across different Kanban columns
Task appears in correct column with assigned priority and tags displayed
Task status updates persist after page reload

title: Real-time Task Monitoring with Embedded VNC and Traffic Analysis
description: Verify tasks can be monitored live with embedded VNC stream and network traffic analysis functionalities.

steps.description: Initiate a running security testing task from Kanban board
Access real-time monitoring view for the task
Embedded VNC stream loads and displays active session
Network traffic monitoring panel shows live captured data
Apply TrafficQL filter to captured traffic
Filtered results update dynamically based on the query
Detect network anomalies via monitoring interface
Anomaly alerts appear accurately and promptly

title: Vulnerability Management - CVE Tracking and AI Analysis
description: Verify vulnerability management system tracks CVEs properly and AI-assisted analysis and PoC code generation functions work correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to vulnerability management interface
Add new CVE to tracking list
The CVE appears with correct details and risk score
Trigger AI-assisted vulnerability analysis
AI confidence scores and analysis results are displayed
Generate proof-of-concept (PoC) code using AI assistance
PoC code is generated and accessible for review
Filter and sort CVEs by severity and status
Filtering and sorting behave correctly and promptly

title: Asset Management and Network Topology Visualization
description: Verify UAV and red team assets are manageable with network topology visualization and accurate risk scoring.

steps.description: Open asset management interface
Add new asset with details such as device type, firmware version, and network parameters
New asset is listed with proper details and risk score computed
Visualize network topology including new and existing assets
Topology diagram accurately reflects asset connections and statuses
Update asset details and confirm UI refreshes accordingly
Changes persist and are reflected in topology and risk score

title: Network Scanning - Firmware and Protocol Analysis
description: Verify network scanning functionality correctly analyzes UAV firmware and network protocols, displaying scan results.

steps.description: Navigate to network scanning interface
Select UAV firmware or protocol to scan
Start scan process
Scan progress is displayed with status updates
Scan results are populated in detailed views upon completion
Validate scan results accuracy by checking known firmware signatures and protocol anomalies
Detected vulnerabilities and details match expected results
Cancel ongoing scan
Scan process stops and UI reflects cancellation

title: Device Management - Device Lists and Details
description: Verify users can view, filter, and edit device lists and detailed device information including firmware and wireless parameters.

steps.description: Open device list view
Filter device list by firmware version, status, or wireless parameters
Filtered device list updates correctly and efficiently
Select a device for detailed view
Device details including firmware, wireless parameters, and associated tasks are displayed
Edit and update device parameters
Changes save successfully and are reflected in the UI
Attempt to input invalid or out-of-range data in device details
Proper validation error messages are shown and invalid data is rejected

title: Containerized AI Agent Monitoring and Logging
description: Verify container monitoring UI displays real-time resource usage, runtime status, and logs for AI agents running in containers.

steps.description: Navigate to container monitoring interface
All running AI agent containers are listed with current status
Select an AI agent container
Resource utilization metrics (CPU, memory, network) are shown and update in real-time
View container logs for the selected agent
Logs load correctly and new log entries appear live
Simulate container restart
UI reflects updated container status and resource metrics after restart

title: Sandbox Environment Isolation and Operation Recording
description: Verify sandbox environment properly isolates operations with VNC access and operational logging enabled for secure testing.

steps.description: Launch sandbox environment for a testing task
Sandbox isolates runtime resources and does not interfere with host system
Access sandbox via provided VNC interface
VNC session provides real-time view and control of sandbox environment
Perform operations within sandbox environment
Stop and close the sandbox session
Operational logs are generated and accurately reflect actions in sandbox
Attempt unauthorized access from outside sandbox
Access is denied and logs show security event

title: AI Agent Task Scheduling, Execution, and Reporting
description: Verify AI agents schedule, execute security testing tasks, and report results correctly through platform interfaces.

steps.description: Create a security testing task and assign it to an AI agent
Trigger scheduling of AI agent for the task
Scheduling completes successfully and agent status updates to running
Allow AI agent to execute and complete the assigned task
Agent reports findings and results to the platform
Review AI-generated analysis, confidence scores, and recommendations
Results are displayed accurately and are accessible in task and vulnerability views
Simulate AI agent failure during execution
Platform detects failure, reports error, and allows retry or reassignment of tasks

title: Configurable Settings Panel and Workspace Layout
description: Verify system configuration can be modified using the settings panel and workspace layout supports panes and sidebar for flexible UI arrangement.

steps.description: Open settings panel from categorized sidebar
Modify several configuration parameters such as UI theme, scheduling intervals, and notifications
Changes are saved and applied immediately or after confirmation
Arrange workspace panes by adding, removing, and resizing
Workspace reflects user layout preferences consistently across sessions
Switch between light and theming color schemes
UI updates colors and elements accordingly with no layout breakage

title: Mission Control Dashboard Drag-and-Drop Functionality
description: Verify drag-and-drop functionality works correctly in Mission Control dashboard’s Kanban board and task list reordering.

steps.description: Navigate to Mission Control dashboard with Kanban board
Drag a task card from one status column to another
Task moves visually and status updates internally
Reorder tasks within the same column by drag-and-drop
Task order updates and persists after page refresh
Attempt drag operation with invalid target destination
Invalid moves are rejected and UI feedback is provided

title: Performance Testing for Task Scheduling and Traffic Analysis
description: Verify the system meets predefined benchmarks for task scheduling, network scanning, and traffic analysis under load.

steps.description: Simulate high volume of concurrent tasks scheduled and running
Task scheduling remains responsive and tasks execute within expected time limits
Perform large network traffic captures and apply complex TrafficQL filters
Traffic analysis UI updates smoothly without lag or crashes
Run extensive firmware scans in parallel
Scanning processes complete within benchmark timeframes and resource usage stays within limits

title: Security and Multi-Tenant Isolation Verification
description: Verify security policies and multi-tenant isolation are enforced by the platform through penetration testing and user boundary enforcement.

steps.description: Attempt unauthorized data access between tenants or missions
Access is denied and audit logs record the attempt
Try privilege escalation exploiting UI or API vulnerabilities
Security controls prevent escalation and maintain role-based access restrictions
Run penetration tests targeting sandbox isolation
Sandbox security holds under all tested attack vectors
Check audit logging and alerting functions are triggered appropriately
All important security events are logged and notify administrators when needed

title: UI Responsiveness and Theming Validation Across Views
description: Verify all major views conform visually to Figma designs, support responsive layouts, and theming with consistent UI elements.

steps.description: Open all major application views including Kanban, asset management, vulnerability management, scanning, traffic monitoring, devices and container monitoring
UI visually matches provided high-fidelity Figma designs with consistent fonts, colors, and element placement
Resize window to small, medium, and large breakpoints
All views adapt layout responsively without content clipping or overlap
Switch between light and configured color schemes
Visual theming updates UI elements consistently without visual artifacts
Verify button states, badges, tabs, cards render uniformly across views
UI controls respond to user interactions correctly with proper state feedback
